title: Legendary Chests
intro: Legendary Chests are diamond chests costing 49 diamonds each. They are the most comprehensive chest type, containing puzzle pieces from almost all other chest types plus their own exclusive animals and the only source of shop cart puzzle pieces.
obtaining_body: Legendary Chests can be obtained from several sources: monthly login rewards, leveling up, the Zoo Academy, the Events Shop, and as quest rewards.
contents_body: Legendary Chests contain puzzle pieces from all other chest types except Friendship and Epic/Retro-exclusive animals. They always guarantee at least one exclusive puzzle piece per chest. They are also the only chest type to contain puzzle pieces for the four Shop Cart decorations.
shop_carts_body: Legendary Chests are the only source of puzzle pieces for the following Legendary-rarity shop decorations:
drop_bonus_body: Legendary Chests feature a rotating drop bonus that boosts the chance of receiving a specific exclusive animal's puzzle pieces. The boosted animal changes every 8 weeks, rotating through the exclusive animal list. This system has been active since November 24, 2022.
animals_body: The following animals are exclusive to Legendary Chests and cannot be obtained through any other chest type:
tips_body: Check which exclusive animal currently has the drop bonus before spending diamonds on Legendary Chests — if you need that animal, it is a good time to open several. Since Legendary Chests contain pieces from most other chests, they are an efficient all-in-one source when you have diamonds to spare. The Shop Cart decorations are Legendary-rarity and only obtainable here, making them valuable for collections.
